item.title: Jail Booking – Livingston County
item.description: A Saint Genevieve, Missouri, woman was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center for Livingston County Wednesday. 38-year-old Kayla Lynn Britt was booked on charges of alleged distribution of a controlled substance. Bond is set at $15,000.
